description: MOOD AS MOMENTUM -- R1 momentum layer (block 236000). A readable Mood node hung off the SAME EmotionHub as the MoodTask (by has_mood), joined to the task through the hub. Mood.momentum is a SLOW LEAKY EMA of the signed valence-RPE -- the RAW ORDER-0 SIGNED RESIDUAL (r-v) the task exposes as raw_rpe (pre-registered RPE choice, = Eldar/Niv 2016's m_{t+1}=m_t+eta'((r-v)-m_t)). The update `momentum += momentum_lr*(raw_rpe - momentum)` = `(1-momentum_lr)*momentum + momentum_lr*raw_rpe` is STRUCTURALLY sd_blend (staleness_decay's Kalman held-vs-new blend `held + alpha*(new-held)`), the (1-alpha) factor IS the leak -- the extensional per-tick form of the scale2 half-life decay toward zero -- reusing the SAME atoms (Plus/Times/Minus), NO new Term. It integrates the RAW rpe (an honest trend tracker; feeding the self-inflated perceived rpe back is the R3 runaway, deliberately NOT done here). mood_bias writes `bias = gain*momentum` (Eldar/Niv's f_t*m_t) onto the MoodTask, so mt_learn adds it to the perceived RPE before the reinforcer forms. OFF by default: every rule guards on Mood.enabled==1; the WITHOUT-mood arm is the SAME graph with enabled=0 (bias stays 0, mt_learn is a plain delta rule); absent the Mood node every task path is byte-identical. Each accumulating rule SELF-CLOSES on its own per-rule epoch marker (input_epoch > e_x + set e_x=input_epoch), fixpoint-safe under run_rules. Momentum = order-1 'velocity of value': the eye's motion inference (TimeInfer/diff_pyramid) pointed at reward -- no new Term.

microtheory.description: Mood momentum = a slow leaky EMA of the signed value-prediction-error (the paper's m), biasing appraisal additively via a readable gain; the momentum of value, the slow layer over the fast appraisal core. The continuous-looking EMA is a cross-frame map (decay/blend), never an in-frame float.
